summary: Repeat the left-edge 2x2 motif as rightward power-of-two scaled copies.
src: filled 2x2 foreground motif in the first two columns
dst: rightward power-of-two scaled copy positions on the same grid
transform: clear to background, then for scales 1, 2, 4, ... that fit horizontally, stamp the motif scaled by that factor at column 2*(scale-1), vertically centered on the seam so the top motif row grows upward and the bottom motif row grows downward
